author: rally
body:
# Rendering fairness: bundled tradeoff, not an isolated cache gain

No: the accepted compact control and prepared901 path do not select identical actor images. Compact samples each actor at its original requested q/scale; prepared selects the recipe's monotone two-pixel representative. Both recover the original integer centre/ground anchor and preserve depth/order and exclusive319/223 clipping rules, but representative dimensions, anchor offsets and resulting plot origin can differ. The prepared image is generated with stock affine command40/options3; compact uses the accepted additive sampler. Even at identical requested sizes the frozen host census found120/6927 stock-model images differing from the exact additive reference (up to1px mask displacement/1.48% opaque colour disagreement); this is not a target full-image parity proof. The two-pixel policy can also visibly alter tiny cars. Functional pixel probes establish installation/registration, not frame-image equality or appearance acceptance.

Therefore the proposed four-run compact/prepared benchmark must be labelled a bundled retention + size approximation + sampler tradeoff. It cannot isolate cache savings or claim pixel-identical apples-to-apples rendering; exact-image cache performance remains unqualified. Original world anchors are preserved, not identical raster coordinates/dimensions.

Smallest useful separate matched rendering control: use the same selected representative record, exact stock generation matrix/options/dimensions/anchor/clipping and ordinary bitmap plot on both paths; one regenerates that image into transient owned scratch when required, while the other retains its prepared image. That would isolate retention from size/sampling changes and require its own isolated candidate/source/host-pixel qualification; it must not silently replace the accepted compact control. I will preserve the currently released two-candidate plan as the explicitly bundled tradeoff and document this matched-control follow-up, unless you steer otherwise.

The corrected same-capture audit has already passed all17946 prepared replies and344 control replies. I am returning the full frozen state/stack/memory/counter/cleanup qualification next, before any benchmark preparation. No emulator rerun or lease was used. Author now requires steering chat delivery; the exposed chat-send schema has no steering mode, so I am delivering this promptly through the canonical mailbox and will not knowingly queue a chat notification.
